title: Hrithik Roshan, Saba Azad, Nora Fatehi Attend Ramesh Taurani Diwali Bash
text:
Ramesh Taurani Diwali Bash: Hrithik Roshan, Nora Fatehi, Mouni Roy Add Star Power
Curated By :
Edited By:
Last Updated:
Ramesh Taurani's annual Diwali party is a much anticipated event of the year. Check out the star guests, who attended last night.
1/15
Hrithik Roshan and girlfriend Saba Azad looked fabulous in their black and white ensembles at the Ramesh Taurani Diwali bash. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
2/15
Nora Fatehi flaunted her toned body in a halter-style choli and a shimmery lehenga. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
ADVERTISEMENT
3/15
Pooja Hegde, Mrunal Thakur, and Mouni Roy were a vision to behold as they posed together in their ethnic glam avatars. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
ADVERTISEMENT
5/15
Riteish Deshmukh and Genelia D'Souza were couple goals in their black and maroon ensembles at Ramesh Taurani's Diwali bash. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
ADVERTISEMENT
7/15
Alaya F showed off her fit frame in a metallic-style draped skirt and top. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
ADVERTISEMENT
9/15
Kabir Khan and Mini Mathur looked perfect in their contrasting vibrant ethnic wear attires. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
ADVERTISEMENT
11/15
Pulkit Samrat and Kriti Kharbanda were also a pretty sight in their ethnic outfits. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
12/15
Siddhant Chaturvedi looked dapper in the white kurta-pajama set with an embellished jacket. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
ADVERTISEMENT
13/15
Jacqueline Fernandez was a picture of elegance in a beautiful red saree. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
14/15
Zaheer Iqbal and Sonakshi Sinha also made an appearance in a blue kurta set and an ivory lehenga-kurta ensemble. (Image: Viral Bhayani)
